preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 500.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly N integers for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 1000 for x in stdout.split())

At least one integer in the output must have an odd frequency in the array.
